reviews.comment: prof street was amazing! took her for COMM 470 and wasn't originally super excited / interested in the class but I learned so much valuable content and actually enjoyed / looked forward to going to this class. Prof Street is so kind, genuinely cares about her students and made lectures beneficial and enjoyable! one of my favorite professors by far!

**COMM 470***
great course, she really cares about her students. she will give you clear criteria and give you ideas for your project and paper. she genuinely loves her job and helping her students. only 2 exams, open book, open note. great class, i would recommend you take this course with street!

Pretty good prof, she does her best to be engaging throughout lectures. The in class group projects are alright, but there are a lot of them. The big group project is pretty easy overall. 3 Exams, open-note, fairly easy.

Whatever you do, do not take her. My group had some trouble with the final and she made it clear she was not going to help us. She relates things to the real world saying, "if you don't cite your sources now, you will not get by when you graduate college". She makes it very clear that we are simply JUST students and she is in charge.

I cant say enough bad things about her. I actually do not have to come in contact with her for this particular class (capstone) so that is a plus. She does not care and will make you feel like a fool, very unkind, and will remind you in several ways that you are just a student and you probably know nothing.

She can teach the content well and knows what she's talking about. But forewarning, don't expect sympathy or understanding from her in almost any aspect. Just take the notes, watch the videos, & make sure to get a good group, it makes the class much easier. One of the only profs I've been too scared to ask questions to.

She is not nice. She cut me off every time I had a question to tell me something random and again each time would cut me off when I told her that is not my question. She also will make you feel like less than her because you are only a student who NEEDS her class to succeed in life! Hard to avoid if you are COMM but just a warning she's not nice.
Very good lectures, as long as you dont get stuck in a bad group you should do fine.

Professor Street was a tough professor. The instructions for many assignments weren't clear and the grading was hard. I had her for both 210 and 324 and regret taking her for two classes. The only reason it was a little better was because I had good groups in both classes, as a group project is a large part of the grade in both classes.
As a prof she is incredibly rude, easy enough class if you can avoid talking with her completely.

Is a terrible human being. Whether you have questions on assignments or any personal issues you need to discuss, she will go out of her way to insult and degrade you. I got told I was lying multiple times. She forgot to add some questions to an online test and so after we had already taken the test she added them and made her retake the test.

As long as you attend class and do the weekly activity packs, you will do fine in this class. Two tests that were open note with mc and writing. A group project is done over the entirety of the semester. I just did my weekly work and made an A. This class is nothing to stress over.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Street is a super nice lady and genuinely wants everyone to do well in her class and in life. There are a lot of assignments, but it's all straightforward and you're allowed to use notes. She's pretty strict on grading, but if you pay attention and attend semi-regularly, you'll do fine in this course!

Street's class was not very exciting content wise, however it was not difficult at all. I took her right after the COVID pandemic and for the first month of class all she talked about was wearing a mask and how football games were going to get canceled due to students not wearing masks.

I was not a fan of Prof. Street. Everything we "learned" in her class I had already learned in previous courses outside of this minor so class was useless. The homework and group project are just busy work, which is very annoying in this junior level class because it is unnecessary work. Least favorite class I took this semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Strictly reviewing as an advisor, Mrs. Street is a very nice woman but a very frustrating advisor to have. You can email her with a simple question, and she nitpicks your email or sends you a cookie cutter response, it sometimes takes like 5 emails before she will actually answer your question or help you. For COMM students, I recommend Joe Rucio.

I am taking this class as a transfer student and I swear this is my hardest class due to the amount of assignments she has us doing. Not only do we have a ton of assignments she also grades these assignments vigorously. If you have questions she will make you feel dumb even asking. Avoid if you do not want to be stressing about a transfer class.

As long as you're not a complete idiot, you can make an A in this class. Prof Street is strict but as long as you don't do anything shady you won't have to deal with her. I can def see how she would talk down to you, but that's prob bc the instructions and assignments were all super straightforward. I honestly took harder classes in high school.

Professor street is a stickler for every single rule. She does everything straight and has no leeway at all, she started the first day by saying if you cheat she will sit in every honor meeting. Dont ask for a grace period or extra credit. Her emails are also honestly rude and she starts every class off by telling everyone to wear their mask.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Nancy is good. Her exams consist of heavy reading. I was lucky enough to be grouped with a good group for the group assignments that are every week. Not a very hard class just pay attention and do well on the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Didn't allow for a diversity of ideas; essay questions on exams had to be tailored to her opinion. Met with her a few times and always felt talked-down to. I was late to a job fair-esque class presentation day because of a last-minute doctor's appointment, and she was short with me when I tried to explain the situation and turn in my doctor's note.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Street can be quite a rude prof. She regularly demonizes students in class. Her tests don't test you knowledge of the material, but rather if you happened to be paying attention at the right time. There is group work every week and she won't move you to a new group if you ask so good luck if your partners don't care. Overall, she doesn't care
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Sweet, but ruthless. Every quiz/test she rewords things to make it more difficult than needed (mostly). The test are open note/book, but sneaky. Still study, fairly easy class other than the tricky test/weekly quizzes. She drops lowest quiz & Group case analysis(in class assignment). One big group project, no final, 3 exams. Exams get easier later
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Class was set up hybrid. If you read the textbook you don't have to go to lecture because she just repeats it all. Responds to emails super fast and really lenient but try to defend your grade and she gets defensive. Make sure you're present on group activity days and you're good. Literally, just memorize + common sense for her tests.

Dr. Parish genuinely cares about all of her students and wants everyone to succeed. The class was very heavily graded on the final group project, but she didn't grade extremely hard on any assignments. She is very clear on what she expects, and her lectures (on Zoom) were very interesting. I HIGHLY recommend taking her if you have the chance.

Professor Street was amazing. I took her online class my first semester back after Corona. She gave no tests, instead we recorded 4 major speeches. She gave lots of feedback and would even look over all your materials before you turn them in. Super sweet lady and super understanding and helpful. I never needed the textbook. No final.

Was a really great professor but her tests were difficult, because they were less content based and more were you paying attention to a line this one dude said in one of these videos. (And Im not saying that because I didnt pay attention) So it was hard/annoying to study because you didnt know what to expect on the test.

This class has a lot of busy work especially near the end of the semester. Professor Street is very clear in her grading for assignments and is available outside of class to help during office hours. Her in class notes are helpful for the exam and so are the study guides. She is a kind person if you get to know her.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: *Had too many other profs doing her job.. (ie. lectures, grading our projects, etc) delights in throwing random questions on exams in hopes no one will make a 100 :) She had guest speakers talk about their professions as a comm major- Most said they wished they had taken more Bus. Classes - and one person booked Santa appearances for a living.

I just took Professor. Street's Comm 101 this semester and got a solid A. Textbook is not necessary (at least I didn't read it at all) nor attendance (but she gives in-class assignment sometimes). All ppts and articles are posted online, be sure to read those! Exams are fairly easy BUT you have to watch those videos that she assigns!

Professor seems nice, but she is very demeaning. Unclear on instructions for almost all assignments, forcing you to go to office hours and she treats you like a child. Mandatory group project and a lot of little assignments. Exams are very easy though, I never studied and made A's on all. Lots of fun guest professors too.

Professor Street is alright. She talks down on you and treats you like a child. She takes attendance often so DO NOT SKIP. Her tests aren't horrible but the project at the end of the semester can be graded harshly. I almost got a C because I had a bad partner.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof Street is really kind and she is enthusiastic when she lectures. The assignments she does give are not all that difficult and a lot of them are done with partners or a group. Exams are not too hard, mostly based on lecture, but going to class is important for passing the tests. The class requires you to be involved but it is not difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Having taken a class from Mrs. Street, experienced her inundation of emails, and met with her in-person multiple times, I can honestly say she is one of A&M's most questionable employees. She is erratic and rude. As a fairly high achieving Honors student, she treated me like a child throughout the semester. Take 101 with someone else if possible.

I loved prof Street & this class! She was my discussion group leader as well & seemed to genuinely care about her students and setting us up for success. She's very passionate about her job and wants students to do well. This class was an easy A for me, but also know some classmates struggled. Overall, as long as you put in effort, you'll do well
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Grading criteria and information are very clear. She is always willing to explain anything to you. Content is very easy. Powerpoints are online. Study guides for tests provided.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She can be a little demeaning at times but is generally nice. follow her instructions PERFECTLY and you'll do fine. class itself is a breeze but don't get cocky. pick your group project partner wisely. homework isn't bad and if you buy the book, it's used as a general all around knowledge base. i overworked by memorizing it and didn't need to
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Overall an easy class. Street is very helpful and clear with her instructions. An easy A.

AMAZING professor. Genuinely cares for each student. Very clear and concise about what she wants you to do to receive an A. Lots of group projects, individual projects. Tests are easy as long as you attend class and show up! But do NOT call her NANCY. Very accessible outside of class and understanding! Do the work, attend class, get an A.

Street is a nice and genuine person overall, but I found some things to be frustrating. She says attendance is mandatory but the only time it really matters is your Friday small group class when you actually sign in for a grade. This class is mainly lectures and half of it is common sense. Some topics are definitely more interesting than others.

Nancy Street is one of the most caring and respected professors in the COMM department. She gives interesting lectures and cares so much about her students. She is always welcome to help you outside of class, even if the matter is not class related. An angel.

She's through when going over material, but she's not a fun person to talk to. Demeaning is probably the best adjective to describe her. I really tried to figure things out in the class myself just so I wouldn't have to talk to her
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I liked the way someone else described Professor Street as demeaning. That is the word I would use too. Even when shown respect and given opportunities to be kind, she feels the need to assert her superiority over her students by being demeaning to them. Was extremely excited about the content of the class at first but her attitude made me hate it.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Prof. Street is a wonderful person & great professor. You will get out of COMM101 what you put into it. You may be freaked out about office hours but if you have any questions at all, she is so helpful. Yes, you have to do assigned reading or you will do significantly worse on the tests. If you go to class/study you'll do well and enjoy this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Street is the best, she truly cares about her students and is so easy to talk to! I loved having her as my COMM 1o1 professor. There is not much homework and when there is its not hard. Her tests are easy as long as you do all the readings required. She makes the lectures very interactive and counts them as attendance.
She is a good prof. Attendance is definitely mandatory, but overall the class was very easy to follow. She is very nice and her lectures are straightforward and easy to pay attention to.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Prof Street is a good lecturer and makes her lectures interesting and engaging. Attendance is necessary. A is definitely attainable.

She is kind of cold. Lectures were boring and there were pop quizzes so it was mandatory you show up. You werent allowed to do anything else in class or else the TAs would approach you, so good luck staying awake. Speech grades depends on TA so hope you get a good one. Had an 89 and she would not give me one point to get an A and ruined my 4.0
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Prof Street loves when people come to her office hours because she likes to chat. She's an easy grader, so if you put in the effort and turn everything in on time, you can make an A. We had a lot of guest speakers in this class; some cool, some boring. Make sure you watch the videos and get the gist of the readings; they're on the tests!
MRS. STREET IS AMAZING real talk

Street is a very good lecturer and keeps it interesting. If you have more than 3 unexcused absences in either the mass lecture or recitation, your grade drops by a whole letter grade. There are 4 speeches and you have to follow her guidelines for all of them. The 2nd one is a group speech.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Street is a very laid back professor that is considerate of your time. So much so that it can be easy to forget about it. Her class isn't hard at all, just make sure you show up. Her test was not difficult , none of the questions were over the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Street is a kind teacher who understands students have a lot on their plates. That being said, don't skip out on doing the assigned work and readings, but she's not a harsh grader. Also, ask questions outside of class, it helps tremendously
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The class is very helpful and (for the most part) easy. However, it is filled with a lot of busy work and pointless facts for the exam. Professor Street can be very demeaning. She will single you out, and use every opportunity she can to embarrass you. If I had to take this class again, I would take it with a different professor. A is achievable.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mrs. Street is a wonderful professor. She is extremely kind and it is obvious that she wants her students to learn. With that said, she doesn't hand out good grades. you'll need to work hard and make sure you're taking care of business, but if you do that, an A is more than attainable with Professor Street.

Professor Street is AMAZING.  Her COMM 101/291 class was my first college course and she made it feel like a breeze.  The book is helpful (I would know, I didn't read it), so I suggest at least skimming through the book before the test.  She is a fair grader, and will always tell you what you did wrong.  Overall, an amazing prof.

Nancy street is great. she explains things well and is very kind during office hours. as a freshman, she helps guide you through your first semester of college on both an educational and personal level. showing up to class is the only solid way to get all the info, she won't do an entire lecture in office hours,but does have test reviews in them

Comm 101/291 with Professor Street was a pretty straightforward class. Choose your group project partners wisely as you will end up working with them a ton. The tests are not terribly difficult and she provides a summary, but she writes them the night before so they can be tricky. Study her slides, reread the textbook, and you'll be good.

Took in Fall 2014. Enjoys her job, does not engage well with students who are struggling and trying to find help. Lots of group work, get people's contact info!!! #1 thing I learned: always carry a stapler in your backpack.
Really easy class. Great professor, very understanding.

Professor Street is mostly really nice and tries to give many examples during the lecture which can sometimes be lengthy and dull if you understood the first time. Group projects and partner work happen quite a bit so it's important to know people in class. She's easy to talk to, but if you ask dumb questions, she can be very dismissive.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Pros: -fairly easy grader -available to help -especially nice if you show interest in the study of Comm -gives test summary, which is extremely helpful  Cons: -demeaning at times -writes the test the night before, so it often includes "read her mind" questions -assigns a ton of busy work and group projects -her lectures can be boring
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Very good. Easy to talk to
reviews.ratingTags: GROUP PROJECTS--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof. Street was jokingly all of Comm 101's mom. She was so sweet and always willing to help. Do the extra credit opportunities because always nice to have in bank! Some projects, some homework but fairly easy. Be ready to work with people all semester long. Don't blow off tests & read the txtbook for them! Lovely lady who really enjoyed teaching!

Mrs. Street makes class fun! She always cracks jokes in lectures and overall made class very enjoyable. . This course does have a lot of homework but majority of assignments are easy 100s. Tests are online and open book/notes so it is very easy to make good grades on those as long as you take good notes in class and have the book in front of you.
Don't call her Nancy, and you'll probably pass! But honestly, she's a good lecturer, she's engaging, the class is kind of blah, but she picks it up and makes it relatively easy.

She tries to be funny when she lectures, but she's easy to understand. She will call you out if your talking to your neighbor or late to class. She can be pretty salty. She does have office hours, but she is very sarcastic and will sometimes make you feel stupid for asking certain questions. She gives extra credit by going to lectures. Tests easy
She is a very involved teacher and is very excited to lecture. The class is pretty easy and simple if you just show up and listen to her lectures. Very easy.

Go to class, because she does in-class activities to make sure you're there.  The best part was that it was 4  hours but we only had to meet once a week, but that meant a lot of outside work was required. She's very funny but kind of intimidating, her office hours were right after class so you could go ask anything and she was very helpful and nice

Expect a letter grade lower than what you think you'll get. She doesn't grade the major projects until the very end, so it's difficult to see where you stand. Don't email asking for help - go to office hours. She is also a morning person, so ask for help at that time of day. Good prof, just has too much on her plate. Her lectures are engaging.

Do all of your assignments on time and you will be fine. Professor Street really does care about her students so take advantage of her officeadvising hours to form a relationship with her and get clarification on anything you may need; she is more than happy to help!

She can be really wishy-washy at times but overall she really cares about her students. She answers most questions but towards the end of the semester she stopped replying to emails when she got busy. She can be a little snappy sometimes but has a lot on her plate. She's a great professor and really helpful. She works with you to do your best.

The famous Muhammad Ali quote "Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee" has never been more true.  Never, ever miss a deadline unless you've talked to her beforehand - she is merciful, but at the same time, if you miss and then ask for forgiveness, you won't get it.  Do the assignments on time, don't be late for class, and you'll be okay.

this class was fairly easy. HOWEVER, she will find EVERY opportunity to show you that she has no mercy whatsoever which can turn an easy A class to one you fail. Late to class too many times? F.  E-learning isn't working for you and you can't do your assignment? Too dang bad. Don't understand the question? It's in the book, figure it out.
BE ON TIME or get called out! Quiz once a week, strictly from the textbook. Easy A. Gives the option to have quiz average count as final exam grade.

EASY CLASS! You will have a reading quiz every monday, but as long as you read then easy A on those. Four speeches. Just memorize them and you'll get an A. If you go to class and have a good quiz average, you won't have to take the final.
Test review is unclear, and will find every opportunity to "give you a 0!"
No Comments
